title: File - Valuations
description: JSON file schema defining a list of valuation objects used in cap tables. Each object includes effective date, stock class ID, valuation type, and price per share, among other fields.

items.title: Object - Valuation
items.description: Object describing a valuation used in the cap table

board_approval_date.description: Date on which board approved the valuation. This is essential for 409A valuations, in particular, which require the Board to approve the valuation.
board_approval_date.title: Type - Date

stockholder_approval_date.description: This optional field tracks when the stockholders approved the valuation.
stockholder_approval_date.title: Type - Date

effective_date.description: Date on which this valuation is first valid
effective_date.title: Type - Date

stock_class_id.description: Identifier of the stock class for this valuation

valuation_type.description: Seam for supporting different types of valuations in future versions
valuation_type.title: Enum - Valuation Type

comments.description: Unstructured text comments related to and stored for the object

file_type.description: File type field (used to select proper schema for validation)
file_type.title: Enum - OCF File Type
